# SameBoy — vendoring notes

Upstream: https://github.com/LIJI32/SameBoy
Pinned commit: `8230189896a8bb6598574d302ba0ad3658f98ab4` (tag `v1.0.3-libretro`)
License: Expat/MIT (`LICENSE`, copied verbatim from the repository root).

See `CoreManifest.kt`'s `sameboy` entry (`app/src/main/java/com/romm/androidtv/emulation/model/CoreManifest.kt`)
for the full license review record (reviewer, date, commercial-use finding).

## What was vendored, and why

Only two subtrees of the upstream repository are needed to build the
libretro core, and neither ever touches the two directories the upstream
`LICENSE` file excludes from the Expat license (`iOS/` and `HexFiend/`,
used only by the unrelated macOS/iOS app frontends):

- `Core/` — the GB/GBC emulation engine, vendored in full (all `.c`/`.h`
  files, including `graphics/*.inc`) even though only the files listed in
  `libretro/Makefile.common`'s `SOURCES_C` are actually compiled
  (`gb.c`, `sgb.c`, `apu.c`, `memory.c`, `mbc.c`, `timing.c`, `display.c`,
  `camera.c`, `sm83_cpu.c`, `joypad.c`, `save_state.c`, `random.c`,
  `rumble.c`). `gb.h` transitively includes every other header in `Core/`
  regardless of which subsystems are compiled in, so the full directory is
  vendored for a simple, auditable 1:1 match with upstream rather than a
  hand-pruned header subset. `debugger.c`/`cheats.c`/`cheat_search.c`/
  `printer.c`/`workboy.c`/`rewind.c`/`symbol_hash.c`/`sm83_disassembler.c`
  are vendored (for the same 1:1-match reason) but **never compiled** — our
  `CMakeLists.txt` only ever compiles the `SOURCES_C` list above, matching
  the flags SameBoy's own libretro build uses to disable those subsystems
  (`-DGB_DISABLE_TIMEKEEPING -DGB_DISABLE_REWIND -DGB_DISABLE_DEBUGGER
  -DGB_DISABLE_CHEATS`).
- `libretro/` — the libretro API wrapper (`libretro.c`, `libretro.h`,
  `libretro_core_options.inc`, `link.T`), plus upstream's own `Makefile`/
  `Makefile.common`/`jni/Android.mk`/`jni/Application.mk` (kept for
  reference/audit only — this project's own `CMakeLists.txt` in this
  directory is what actually builds the core, not these upstream files).
- `BootROMs/` — SameBoy's own from-scratch reimplemented boot ROMs, shipped
  as `.asm` source (`agb_boot.asm`, `cgb_boot.asm`, `cgb0_boot.asm`,
  `dmg_boot.asm`, `mgb_boot.asm`, `sgb_boot.asm`, `sgb2_boot.asm`,
  `cgb_boot_fast.asm` — the last is unused by the libretro build but kept
  for a complete 1:1 mirror of upstream's `BootROMs/` directory), plus
  `hardware.inc`/`sameboot.inc` (shared includes), `pb12.c` (a tiny native
  host-side compressor for the embedded SameBoy logo bitmap), and
  `SameBoyLogo.png` (the logo bitmap itself, used only at boot-ROM-build
  time, never shipped in the app). **Not** Nintendo's copyrighted boot ROM
  binaries — this is SameBoy's own MIT-licensed, functionally-compatible
  replacement, and it is not excluded from the Expat license.
- `libretro/generated/*.c` — the actual boot ROM byte arrays the libretro
  core embeds at compile time (`agb_boot.c`, `cgb_boot.c`, `cgb0_boot.c`,
  `dmg_boot.c`, `mgb_boot.c`, `sgb_boot.c`, `sgb2_boot.c`), checked in as
  generated output rather than regenerated by our Gradle/CMake build,
  because producing them requires the RGBDS toolchain (`rgbasm`/`rgblink`,
  MIT-licensed, https://rgbds.gbdev.io), which is not part of this project's
  Android/NDK build toolchain. See "Regenerating the boot ROMs" below for
  the exact reproducible command sequence if `BootROMs/*.asm` ever changes
  (e.g. on a future SameBoy version bump).

## Regenerating the boot ROMs

Requires RGBDS (`brew install rgbds` on macOS) and the upstream repository
checked out at the pinned commit above:

```sh
cd <upstream SameBoy checkout>
make bootroms   # builds build/bin/BootROMs/*.bin via rgbgfx + pb12 + rgbasm + rgblink

for name in agb_boot cgb_boot cgb0_boot dmg_boot mgb_boot sgb_boot sgb2_boot; do
  bin="build/bin/BootROMs/${name}.bin"
  out="${name}.c"
  echo "/* AUTO-GENERATED */" > "$out"
  echo "const unsigned char ${name}[] = {" >> "$out"
  hexdump -v -e '/1 "0x%02x, "' "$bin" >> "$out"
  echo "};" >> "$out"
  echo "const unsigned ${name}_length = sizeof(${name});" >> "$out"
done
```

This is exactly the transformation upstream's own `libretro/jni/Android.mk`
performs at its own build time; we ran it once against the pinned commit and
checked in the result instead of re-running it on every build.
